text: The Public Investment Corporation had a significant beneficial interest of 15.7% in FirstRand's issued ordinary shares in the year ended 30 June 2025.
short: The PIC holds 15.7% of FirstRand's ordinary shares.

source.name: FirstRand Limited Group Annual Financial Statements 2025 (PDF)
